displayName.en: Low Limit Supervisory Control Enable Request

description.en: A binary parameter written by a supervisory control system to request control of the low limit parameter, and set 'false' to hand control back. The request is not authoritative on its own: the local controller honours it only while its data quality test on the accompanying Low Limit Supervisory Control Heartbeat is passing. Whether the low limit parameter is presently being driven is represented separately by Low Limit Supervisory Control Active.
